text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain felt satisfying, but a gain over my average cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should decide using my plan for the position.","I should not treat recent price changes as forecasts: prices are random, so past gains or losses do not tell me what comes next.","Because I check only occasionally, I should set clear portfolio rules in advance and avoid letting reluctance to admit a mistake or discomfort with losses drive my trades."]}
